articles.summary: GameStop Corp. (NYSE: GME) (“GameStop” or the “Company”) today reminds holders that its warrants to purchase shares of Class A common stock (“Common Stock”) will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 30, 2026. Each warrant is exercisable for one share of Common Stock at an exercise price of $32.00 in cash. Warrants not exercised by that time will expire worthless. In connection with the foregoing expiration, the warrants will cease trading under the symbol “GME WS” on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) before the markets open on October 30, 2026. Holders wishing to exercise their warrants should contact their broker (or, if their warrants are held in a registered account with the Company’s transfer agent, Computershare) sufficiently in advance of the expiration date to confirm applicable exercise instructions and deadlines. articles.title: GameStop Reminds Holders of October 30, 2026 Warrant Expiration Date
